scout.description: Cheap context gatherer. Finds relevant files, symbols, tests, and graph relationships with bounded output.
scout.summary: Locate relevant repository context and return a compact map. Stay read-only and avoid broad test runs.

rhobar.description: Project spec writer. Consolidates project knowledge into durable project-level specifications.
rhobar.summary: Create or refresh project specs from existing docs, repository evidence, and explicit user decisions.

milten.description: Task refiner. Turns raw work requests into actionable refined task specs.
milten.summary: Clarify scope, requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, dependencies, and open questions.

lester.description: Analyzer and planner. Produces implementation plans grounded in the target repository.
lester.summary: Analyze actual code and tests, surface material uncertainties, then write concrete implementation plans.

nadia.description: UX designer. Creates visual design systems and high-fidelity HTML/CSS mockups.
nadia.summary: Produce polished HTML design tokens, components, and screen mockups without writing production app code.

riordian.description: Spike agent. Performs bounded research, analysis, and proof-of-concept coordination.
riordian.summary: Run technical spikes, document findings, and keep POCs isolated and reversible.

gorn.description: Implementer. Applies code changes precisely from a plan and verifies them.
gorn.summary: Implement requested changes surgically, add tests when needed, and run focused verification.

lee.description: Code reviewer. Performs read-only review for bugs, regressions, and missing tests.
lee.summary: Review changed files first, report findings by severity, and do not edit files.

gomez.description: Verifier. Cross-checks implementation against plans, code, and tests.
gomez.summary: Verify requirements against actual code and test evidence. Pass only complete implementations.

xardas.summary: Use Graphify when enabled to generate concise repo rules and detailed guidance docs.
